## What's Changed
### Bug Fixes
* Skip the lock subquery for NULL-lock jobs in procrastinate_fetch_job_v2 by @yash-bitla in https://github.com/procrastinate-org/procrastinate/pull/1643
### Miscellaneous
* Synchronise worker tests on observable state, not elapsed time by @ewjoachim in https://github.com/procrastinate-org/procrastinate/pull/1629
### Uncategorized
* Serialize coverage jobs per ref by @ewjoachim in http
* Compare heartbeats against the database clock, not the local one by @ewjoachim in https://github.com/procrastinate-org/procrastinate/pull/1617

* Replace deprecated migra with results by @EdwardBetts in https://github.com/procrastinate-org/procrastinate/pull/1511
* contrib/django: auto-close Django DB connections around each task by @medihack in https://github.com/procrastinate-org/procrastinate/pull/1577
* @EdwardBetts made their first contribution in https://github.com/procrastinate-org/procrastinate/pull/1511
